title: The Prince of Liechtenstein walked up to a UFO in the mountains

tellings.quote: that in and Lawrence told us that you know because he said that's why he was so convinced that it was true that his friend who was the prince of Likenstein had seen one

plain: The Prince of Liechtenstein is said to have walked up to a UFO in the mountains. Dan Sheehan, a guest on the show, says the philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller told him and the psychiatrist John Mack about it, and that this friend's sighting was why Rockefeller was so convinced UFOs were real. It matters to the tellers because it shows a powerful man's belief resting on a first-hand account from someone he trusted.
